provenance.interpretation: BioEmu generates num_samples conformations; filter_samples publishes only the physically valid ones. XTC frames are sample order, not physical time; no population weight, kinetics, or original sample id is published.

limitations: A generated ensemble is a model sample and not a measured thermodynamic population.
